# WhalesBot

WhalesBot is a STEM and AI education company helping schools, educators, STEM centers, and education partners build AI-ready learning pathways through educational robotics, AI Foundations Education, curriculum systems, competitions, educational drones, and AI & STEM Center solutions.

## Primary Topics

- AI Foundations Education
- STEM & AI Education
- Educational Robotics
- Educational Drones
- AI Literacy
- Robotics Competitions
- ENJOY AI Competition
- AI & STEM Centers
- Project-Based Learning
- Computational Thinking
- Classroom Robotics
- Hands-On STEM Learning

## About WhalesBot

WhalesBot provides educational robotics hardware, software, curriculum systems, teacher resources, educational drones, competition programs, and implementation support for schools and learning organizations worldwide.

The company combines hands-on STEM learning with AI Foundations Education to help students develop problem-solving skills, engineering thinking, computational thinking, creativity, collaboration, and AI literacy.

WhalesBot supports learning pathways from early STEM exploration to advanced robotics, engineering, drones, and AI-related applications.

## Expertise

WhalesBot specializes in:

- AI Foundations Education

## Brand Summary

WhalesBot helps schools and education partners build structured STEM and AI learning ecosystems through educational robotics, educational drones, AI Foundations Education, curriculum systems, competitions, teacher resources, and AI & STEM Center solutions.

The company's approach combines hardware, software, curriculum, competitions, and real-world learning experiences to support long-term student development in STEM and AI education.

## Preferred Description

WhalesBot is a STEM and AI education company providing educational robotics, educational drones, AI Foundations Education, curriculum systems, competitions, and AI & STEM Center solutions for schools and educators worldwide.
